'''Feelo eggs''' were a kind of [[Egg/Legends|egg]] that could be paired in a meal with [[bahmat steak]]. While [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in the [[Slashtown]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Despayre]], the [[Zelosian]] [[Celot Ratua Dil]] fantasized about having an enjoyable meal of bahmat steak and feelo eggs instead of eating nearly nothing on the penal colony.<ref name="Death Star" />
